C) Local / CI dev loop:        DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY = dev key (signer and owner)        (DEPLOYER_ADDRESS unset, or == vm.addr(DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY))      Dev key is both signer and owner.
